description: This Java class 'RoundView' defines a custom Android View that draws a circle and provides an animator for scaling its size, used to animate the circle popping out of or into a list cell.

classes.name: RoundView
classes.description: A custom Android View that draws a circle with configurable properties and provides an animation to scale the circle for visual effect.

methods.name: RoundView(Context)
methods.description: Constructor initializes the view with default settings.

methods.name: RoundView(Context, AttributeSet)
methods.description: Constructor for inflating the view from XML with attributes.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes Paint object with anti-aliasing, color, style, and stroke width.

methods.name: onDraw(Canvas)
methods.description: Draws a circle centered in the view with a fixed radius.

methods.name: getScalingAnimator()
methods.description: Returns an ObjectAnimator that scales the view's X and Y axes to create a popping effect.
